inputs.raw_model_output: A strict tau2-telecom-trajectory-0.1 JSON object, optionally enclosed in a single JSON Markdown fence.

response_schema.assistant_message: string; retained as dialogue content but not scored because COMMUNICATE is absent from reward_basis

procedure: Parse and validate the strict JSON response contract.
Create the selected item's relevant default Telecom state and apply its native initialization_actions in order.
Replay every declared user-tool call in order. toggle_roaming is a state toggle, not an action-presence shortcut; read tools do not modify state.
Evaluate every native env_assertion against the resulting relevant state.
Multiply assertion rewards as native ENV_ASSERTION aggregation does; return pass and score 1 only if every assertion is met.
non_goals: This compact adapter does not reproduce the upstream live half-duplex orchestrator or LLM user simulator.
It implements only tools and state fields reachable and score-relevant for this materialized item.
It does not add ACTION or COMMUNICATE rewards that are absent from the selected item's reward_basis.
invocation: Send one JSON request on stdin; read one JSON result from stdout.
